updates.text: Smith followed the flow on Counter July 30 and left the wrap gap. Bush corrected his read of the puller; he fitted the same misdirection correctly August 1. That is one retained correction, not a closed run-defense assessment.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Telvin Smith, a fourth-round pick in 2014, has been active for {{2014.regular.games:words}} games as a rookie and made {{2014.regular.special_teams_tackles:words}} tackles on special teams. He is a lean, fast linebacker whose speed, range in pursuit and ball skills are his strengths. His light frame is the question in the run game, and taking on blocks is the weakest part of his game.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
